recommended_action: Immediately circuit-break or throttle traffic to llm-gemini to halt cascading failures; investigate LLM provider health and consider failover to a backup LLM endpoint. Simultaneously review tool-executor retry/timeout policies to prevent further tool failure accumulation (214 failures). Monitor payments-service and postgres-payments closely for data integrity issues, and validate auth-service stability to avoid broader authentication outages.
summary: A confirmed llm_degradation scenario is causing severe system-wide impact: 23.7% of all spans are in error state and p99 latency has spiked to over 24 seconds. The degradation is cascading from llm-gemini through tool-executor (48.4% error rate, 214 tool failures), agent-service (36.9%), and api-gateway (61.1%), with secondary pressure on payments and auth pipelines.
